claims.explanation: Digoxin kills cancer cells primarily by inhibiting the Na+/K+-ATPase (ATP1A1), so high target expression and pathways that amplify ionic/metabolic stress (e.g., PI3K/AKT activation via PTEN loss or PIK3CA mutation, Wnt/MAPK dependencies) are expected to sensitize. Conversely, P-glycoprotein (ABCB1)-mediated efflux and anti-apoptotic BCL2 expression protect cells, while the observed sensitive lines are strongly enriched for PI3K/PTEN alterations and several other oncogenic lesions.
